== Summary ==
Two games at the [[2008 Match Play Championship]], January 2008. Flickr caption by Nate Meeker: "Dan v Yeager + Booker v Hollingsworth". [[James Booker]] is one of the players; the caption gives only surnames or first names for the others, and the faces are not marked.

== Source ==
Photo by [[Nate Meeker]], Flickr: [https://www.flickr.com/photos/53301220@N00/2173892237/ DSCN0086 Dan v Yeager + Booker v Hollingsworth] (original image https://live.staticflickr.com/2062/2173892237_f251a9ba07_b.jpg). Album linked in [https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=254001#p254001 post by Meeker] (Nate Meeker), "Nate Meeker PICTURES!", Star Wars CCG Players Committee Forums, 7 January 2008, linking his Flickr album "MPC 2008 GG". Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261105005855/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t18290.html Internet Archive]
